## Description {#details}

This source file provides the implementation of the <code>test&#95;reporter</code> class and associated functions, which are responsible for formatting and presenting test results within the µTest++ framework.

It includes operator overloads for a variety of data types, containers, and comparator expressions, as well as methods for reporting the commencement and completion of test cases and suites, and for handling both successful and failed outcomes. The implementation supports multiple verbosity levels and colour-coded output to clearly distinguish between passing and failing tests.

All definitions reside within the <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</Link></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.

<SectionDefinition>

## Functions

### endl() {#ac49ee935c294cb18a5a0e7f58b0b9fb4}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>test&#95;reporter &amp; micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::endl (test&#95;reporter &amp; stream)</>}>
Output stream manipulator for ending a line in test reports.

---

The <code>endl</code> function acts as a stream manipulator for the <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</Link></code>, inserting a line ending into the output buffer and flushing the current content if necessary. This ensures that test report output is clearly separated and formatted, improving readability and professionalism in the presentation of test results.

Using <code>endl</code> in conjunction with the <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</Link></code> output operators provides a familiar and convenient mechanism for managing line breaks, similar to standard C++ stream manipulators.


<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="stream">Reference to the <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</Link></code> instance.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
Reference to the same <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</Link></code> instance, enabling chaining of output operations.
</SectionUser>

The <code>endl</code> function inserts a newline character into the specified <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</Link></code> stream and flushes its output buffer. This operation ensures that each test output line is clearly separated and immediately visible, facilitating the readability and clarity of test results across all test cases and folders within the µTest++ framework.
